The KESS3 requires an active subscription to receive software updates, protocol releases, online services and technical support, all of which ensure your tuning workflow stays current, efficient and scalable for your business or workshop.  

Renewing proactively means uninterrupted access to new vehicle protocols and improvements as they’re released. Even if your subscription has lapsed, we can help you reactivate it. 

You can only purchase your subscription renewal from VIEZU if your Alientech KESS3 tool was purchased through us. Otherwise, renewals must be purchased directly from your tool’s Master. 

Why Renew Your Subscription? 

  • Latest protocol updates – stay ahead with support for new vehicles and features.  
  • Technical support & tuning files – access professional help and ready-built tuning resources from the VIEZU team.  
  • Online services remain active – including web services and tool management.  
  • Flexible durations – choose what fits your schedule and workload.  

How it works:

Choose your Activation Type: Master or Slave (Client) and select your Subscription Type:

Early Renewal: If you renew before your subscription expiry date – Renew for 12 months, save 20% off the standard subscription renewal fee.

Standard Renewal: If you are late renewing your KESS3 subscription, a standard renewal will renew your subscription for 12 months.

Reactivation: If your KESS3 subscription renewal has passed 12 months of the expiration date, you will need to purchase a KESS3 Reactivation. This will reactivate your subscription for 12 months. Your new subscription expiry date will be 12 months from the date of activation.

With a valid subscription, your KESS3 keeps delivering full functionality – no features missed, no interruptions to tuning work. 

Advantage of a KESS3 Slave Tuning Tool 

One of the advantages of a slave tuning tool from VIEZU is that ready-to-use tuning files with backup and support are available without the need for technical file writing knowledge. Alientech KESS3 slave tuning files will be provided by a master tuning file provider – typically, VIEZU provides these files. The technical support team is ready to assist you. Tuning support from VIEZU will include ECU and TCM remapping and tuning files, training and support for your business. VIEZU tuning files are fast, reliable, and custom. 

We offer free training and support seven days a week. Find out more about VIEZU dealer support here: Become a Dealer

short_description:
This ECU holder is built for professional car tuners who need a safe and reliable way to support an ECU during bench work. It securely holds the control unit in place while programming, reading, writing, or testing, helping to protect connectors and reduce the risk of data interruption.

Power and communication cables remain properly supported, keeping everything stable and organised. Ideal for daily workshop use, it helps maintain ECU safety, data integrity, and consistent power throughout every tuning session.
description:
Working on an ECU demands stability and control, especially during programming and data transfer. A poorly supported unit can shift unexpectedly, strain connectors, or interrupt power and communication, all of which can lead to data corruption or hardware damage. This ECU holder is designed to eliminate those risks and create a more dependable working setup.

Built with professional tuners in mind, it provides a secure platform for holding ECUs during reading, writing, cloning, or testing on the bench. The holder keeps the unit firmly positioned while still allowing easy access to all connectors and cables. This helps protect sensitive pins, reduces stress on wiring, and keeps power supplies stable throughout longer tuning sessions.

By keeping the ECU in a consistent position, the holder also improves workflow and organisation. There is less need to reposition the unit or manage trailing cables, which saves time and reduces distractions when working on complex calibration tasks. It is equally suited to busy workshops and mobile tuning setups where reliability is critical.

Simple in concept but highly effective in practice, this ECU holder supports safer working habits and more consistent results. For professional car tuners who value equipment protection and data security, it is a practical addition that quickly becomes part of everyday bench work.

Autotuner One is a personal-use ECU and TCU tuning device that puts professional tuning within reach, with no workshop visit, no laptop and no complex setup required.

VAG ECU and TCU tuning with Autotuner One

Autotuner One supports selected VAG gearbox tuning applications, allowing compatible Audi, Volkswagen, SEAT, Škoda, Cupra and Porsche owners to tune both the engine ECU and gearbox TCU using the same personal tuning device.

ECU tuning can improve power, torque and response, while TCU tuning helps the gearbox make better use of that performance. For many VAG vehicles, combining ECU and TCU tuning gives a more complete result than engine tuning alone.

Supported VAG gearbox families currently include DQ200, DQ250, DQ381, DQ500, DL382 and DL501. Compatibility depends on the exact vehicle, gearbox, ECU and software version, so please contact VIEZU before ordering.

  • Includes original file backup and restore functions

  • Built-in ECU and TCU identification features, where supported
